title: Common
description: Shared building blocks used by every other Agents One schema. This file has no root type; reference its $defs. All patterns are RE2-compatible (no lookaround) so Go validators accept them.

AgentName.description: Agent name. Lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, 1 to 31 characters. Also the Linux user name of a custom agent.

Ulid.description: A ULID: 26 characters of Crockford base32, upper case. The first 10 encode milliseconds since the Unix epoch, so ids sort by creation time.

AnyId.description: Any prefixed id: a lowercase prefix of 2 to 4 letters, an underscore, and a ULID.

MessageId.description: Bus or chat message id, prefix msg_.

TurnId.description: Runner turn id, prefix trn_. The daemon assigns it when it wakes a runner.

ChatId.description: Chat id, prefix cht_. One chat is one conversation between humans and one agent.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a Z suffix and 0 to 9 fraction digits. Offsets other than Z are not allowed, so one instant has one spelling (this matters for audit hashes).

OneLine.description: One line of plain text: 1 to 255 characters, no line breaks.

Markdown.description: CommonMark text, up to 64 KiB of characters.

Semver.description: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version, without a leading v.

SemverRange.description: A version range in node-semver syntax, for example ">=1.2.0 <2.0.0" or "^1.4.0".

Sha256Hex.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

ActorKind.description: Who acted. agent: an agent in the society. human: a human account. system: the daemon or one of its emitters inside the VM. host: the host tool on the Mac.

AuditActor.description: Who did something, as an object (used in audit records). The one-string form is ActorRef.

name.description: Agent name, human user name, or component name such as agentsoned or emitter-auth.

uid.description: Linux uid seen through socket peer credentials, when known. Root agents share uid 0; their name and cgroup tell them apart.

ActorRef.description: Who did something, as one string (used where only strings fit, such as CloudEvents extension attributes): <kind>:<name>, for example agent:founder or human:alice.

ChartScope.description: Which part of the org chart something concerns, as one string. machine: the whole machine. team:<root>: the chart branch whose root agent is <root>. agent:<name>: one agent.

EventType.description: Event type: agentsone.<emitter>.<event>, dot-separated lowercase segments, for example agentsone.auth.login.failed.

EventTypeFilter.description: An event type, or a prefix ending in .* that matches every type below it, for example agentsone.auth.*.

PluginPath.description: A file or directory inside a plugin: starts with ./ or ${PLUGIN_ROOT}/, uses forward slashes, and has no segment that starts with a dot, so it cannot escape the plugin root. Claude Code's ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} maps to ${PLUGIN_ROOT}.

SkillName.description: Agent Skills name: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen. Must equal the skill's directory name.

PluginName.description: Plugin name in kebab-case: lowercase letter first, then lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, up to 64 characters.

EnvMap.description: Environment variables for a process. Values may contain ${PLUGIN_ROOT}.
